svg.title: J1 First visit and ask (the order per message)

g.text: J1 First visit and ask (the order per message)
a question in the link (?q=) is asked on load
A store fault is noted, never thrown: the clinic file
that ships with the app is used and the reply still goes out.
Rejected: a doctor who is not in the file, a figure for
another service, a time for another day, a clock time
without am or pm. A rejected answer goes to step 5.
"Not found" becomes "not sure" and a needs human ticket.
[no key, a failed or late call, or a rejected answer]
